purpose: Response shapes for the later appointment screen (FUCQ-120). Backend-only story: no screen, so screenshots are inapplicable. Asserted by server/test/gcsp-lifecycle-appointment.test.js.

routes.GET /api/gcsp/appointments?orderUuid=: ok readModel; employee (own order), greg or presenter; forbidden for another employee; unsupported query keys are invalid
routes.POST /api/gcsp/appointments/request: { orderUuid, slotId } -> ok readModel (state requested, booked false); employee only; repeat returns the same appointment; another slot is a conflict; before sent to ordering it is a conflict
routes.POST /api/gcsp/appointments/accept: { orderUuid, proposalId } -> ok readModel (state scheduled, booked true); employee only; conflict when nothing is proposed

requested.nextStep: Waiting for the retailer to confirm your slot.

change-proposed.nextStep: Accept the new time to confirm your handover.

pending.nextStep: Waiting for the scheme team to confirm the last update.

scheduled.nextStep: The retailer prepares your car for the handover.
